map.：月用电 600 kWh、当地年发电 1300 kWh/kWp、组件单价 3.5: : With 600 kWh monthly consumption, 1300 kWh/kWp local annual yield, 3.5 CNY/W module price, and a 0.58 CNY/kWh tariff: recommended capacity about 5.5 kWp, annual output about 7150 kWh covering roughly 80% of consumption, initial investment about 19250 CNY, and a payback of about 7–9 years. Note that subsidies and rising tariffs shorten the payback.
map.自发自用和余电上网哪种收益高？: Which Is More Profitable, Self-Consumption or Selling the Surplus?
map.自发自用节省零售电价，通常高于上网电价，因此提升自用率（加储能、错峰用电）收益更: Self-consumption saves the retail tariff, which is usually higher than the feed-in price, so raising the self-consumption ratio (with storage and off-peak usage) pays better; feed-in only handles the surplus.
map.回收期受哪些因素影响最大？: Which Factors Affect the Payback Period Most?
map.当地辐照、自用比例、初始投资单价与电价/补贴政策；辐照高且自用率高时回收期显著缩: Local irradiance, self-consumption ratio, initial investment per watt, and tariff or subsidy policy; with high irradiance and a high self-consumption ratio the payback period shortens markedly.
